# Bollsen Hearing Protection

> Bollsen manufactures eco-friendly, reusable medical-grade silicone earplugs for sleep, music, water sports, motorcycles, work, and children with advanced noise reduction technology.

Bollsen offers a comprehensive range of hearing protection products engineered for specific use cases, from the Life+ sleep earplugs with 24dB noise reduction to specialized solutions like Watersafe+ for water activities and Moto+ for motorcycle riders. The company emphasizes comfort, reusability, and medical-grade materials compliant with EU standards.
